label: Visioning
definition: The owner is forming a vision for the location.

label: Masterplan adopted
definition: A masterplan has been adopted or approved, and no planning application has yet been made.

label: Committee
definition: An application is with the planning authority, or the authority has resolved to grant it and the decision has not yet been issued.

label: Consented
definition: Planning permission or another consent has been granted, and construction has not started.
